scope: Phase 1 audit artifacts only; no application or indexing changes. Existing local production build, not deployed site verification.
checks: All census distributions and completeness totals reconcile
Sample contains at least 100 distinct records and covers every observed category/country
All 237 HTML pages have HTTP 200, one H1, expected canonical and metadata matching the refreshed manifest
All sample robots match the existing policy
JSON-LD syntax parsed on all pages
XML contains 569 publication URLs and all 25 approved guide details without duplicates or sample policy mismatches

Public API shape discrepancy reproduced on one mobile detail endpoint
TypeScript, focused ESLint, Python compilation and git diff whitespace checks passed
